messages:
alex: kicking off staged rollout -> v2.3.1 to EU at 5% (canary). change window 21:00-23:00 UTC. ping @liz @mike for oncall watch
deploy-bot: deploy job started: id=deploy-1764321987, target=eu, pct=5, from=v2.3.0 to=v2.3.1
sara: noticing a small bump in rerank errs in EU — 0.2% -> 1.1% in 3m on the canary shard
liz: seeing the same in tracing. throwing an alert to the reranker owners. correlating with model variant and kv-cache changes
mike: can you paste a quick error sample?
sara: quick snippet: ```json
{"error":"KeyError","msg":"missing token in rerank pipeline"}
```
liz: looks like the quantized variant (8bit-fast) was used for the EU canary. probable quality regression. suggestion: route EU traffic back to v2.3.0 for that percent and hold
alex: ok — proposal: soft rollback for EU 5% only (pin to v2.3.0), hold global ramp. ops-ash can you run the traffic-swap? recommend 5m hold window after swap
ops-ash: running swap now: `redwoodctl traffic swap --region eu --from v2.3.1 --to v2.3.0 --pct 5`
deploy-bot: command accepted: executing traffic swap...
deploy-bot: result: success=true, swapped_pct=5, region=eu, job=swap-1764321995
jordan: any sign of customer-facing failures or complaints?
sara: not seeing external tickets yet, internal eval set shows embeddings/rerank quality delta ~5% worse on v2.3.1 samples
liz: conservative call: pin EU to v2.3.0 until a patched variant is validated. open rollback ticket and notify support to watch for any late reports
alex: creating rollback ticket ROLL-4821 and updating release notes. also pausing progressive rollout (no global ramp)
kevin: infra side — will hold any auto-rollouts for EU reserved pools and disable canary autobump for that region
deploy-bot: canary hold flag set: `canary.hold=eu` reason="quality regression"
mike: :thumbsup: want a 5-10m observation window after swap; please confirm metrics trending to baseline
sara: metrics trending back near baseline. errs down to ~0.25% in the last 4m. running local eval on patched build now
alex: decision: stop progressive rollout, pin EU to v2.3.0, abort global ramp. cut patch tonight in change window and validate before any further rollout. reconvene in 30m or earlier if anything changes
jordan: noted — update customer-facing blurb: "temporary routing to previous model due to brief quality regression; no data exposure"
liz: I'll open a follow-up checklist and postmortem template if patch slips past the window. traces archived at s3://redwood-logs/rollbacks/1764321987
deploy-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1187 linked to ROLL-4821
mike: closing loop for now — great quick response. please ping if support sees uptick or if rollback needs to expand
alex: thanks team, reverting canary flag in infra console and leaving EU pinned until patch validated. :wave:
